    How to use it

    1. Drop or choose a sprite sheet (or try the sample).
    2. Cut it by cell size, by rows × columns, or let Auto find the sprites.
    3. Tap frames to pick them in order. Watch the preview.
    4. Download the frames as a .zip, or just the JSON map.
